 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'parliment'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'parliament'.**
 
• The word '**parliament**' is a **noun** which means 'the supreme legislative body in a country'. **(संसद)**
 
 
• **For Example -**
 
• The bill was passed in parliament with a majority vote.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be** 'parliment'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other correctly spelled words - **

 
• **Perceive -** become aware or conscious of (something); come to realize or understand **(समझना)**
 
• **Pastime -** an activity that someone does regularly for enjoyment rather than work; a hobby **(मनोरंजन)**
 
• **Perseverance -** persistence in doing something despite difficulty or delay in achieving success **(धैर्य)**
